# go-modern-context-cancel-cause

**Since:** Go 1.20

## Summary

Use context.WithCancelCause and context.Cause when cancellation needs to carry an error cause.

## Details

Cancellation causes let code record why a context was canceled.
Callers can inspect context.Cause(ctx) instead of only seeing the broad ctx.Err result.

## Examples

### Before

```go
ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(parent)
cancel()
```

### After

```go
ctx, cancel := context.WithCancelCause(parent)
cancel(err)
cause := context.Cause(ctx)
```
